newsitem.title: CHINA: Cheung Kong says new flats 50X subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Cheung Kong says new flats 50X subscribed.

text.p: Cheung Kong Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday the sale of 470 flats at its residential development in Shatin in the New Territories was 50 times subscribed.

The property developer said in a statement more than 10,000 potential buyers registered for the first batch of units available for at Vista Paradiso, a joint venture project equally owned by Cheung Kong and Concord Land Development Co Ltd.
The units will be sold on July 26. The price ranges from HK$6,148 to HK$6,677 per square foot.
Vista Paradiso has about 2,030 residential units.
